title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.91
summary: Cloud-Aufnahmen: wartende Clip-Anfragen, deduplizierte Medienantworten und sparsamere 360p-Transcodierung.
changes: Queue up to eight pending read-only recording clip requests instead of immediately rejecting on two active encoders
Reuse 90-second short clip cache and deduplicate concurrent requests for the same clip
Reduce cloud-only transcoding to 360p at 12 fps for lower CPU and bandwidth
Work with private PHP 3.0.8 with responsive date filter and clearer HLS error handling
Preserve original recording data, camera registration, users and mobile app entry
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.91
description: Playback reliability and smartphone layout hotfix for private cloud recording archive
releaseNotes: Install private Plesk PHP V3.0.8 first, then camera server 2.20.91. Real Plesk and iOS playback still need verification.
